acceptance: historical MaxRESULTS resolves to current canonical identity and cannot be selected as current
live Git HEAD is distinguishable from recorded/stale HEAD
UNKNOWN cannot be promoted to VERIFIED

cold-start validator fails closed on stale/conflicting/unsupported state
every substantive execution carries a complete successor payload
one-shot execution explicitly requires ten-first judgment without guessing or bypassing verification
a blocker handoff contains an executable recovery path rather than a bare failure statement
No-Orphan law is reachable from mandatory START-HERE boot and included in cold-start acceptance
active_block.next_action: Obtain a fresh current-head Naya Control Plane and Smart Brain v3 Enforcement result after the No-Orphan boot/acceptance repair.
